why: THE CORPUS WITHOUT THIS FILE NEVER ENTERED THE OpenLoop ARM. Measured, not
feared: evidence/PowerControlSetpoints/probes/arm_census.txt counts every
arm of the translation over the 3596-case corpus and reports
calls 3596 | PRC_Mode==2  17 | Constant 1 | OpenLoop 1 | ZMQ 1
Ind_R_Speed>0 0 | Ind_R_Torque>0 0 | Ind_R_Pitch>0 0 | WRITE(401,*) 0
the ELSE arm 3579
so eleven of this unit's twenty statements -- three interp1d calls and the
record written to unit 401 -- were reached by NO case, and a mutation score
on that corpus would have called every mutant in them a survivor.
WHY, EXACTLY, AND IT IS ARITHMETIC RATHER THAN BAD LUCK. R6 crosses the
quantities the reference's own predicates test. This unit has six knobs --
Ind_R_Pitch, Ind_R_Speed, Ind_R_Torque (4 values each), PRC_Comm (5),
PRC_Mode (4), aviFAIL (4) -- and 4*4*4*5*4*4 = 5120, past generate.py's
_KNOB_CASE_LIMIT of 4096. So the block falls back to ALL PAIRS, and in the
fallback every knob that is not one of the two being crossed is held at the
FIRST value of its ladder: PRC_Mode = 0. Reaching the WRITE needs PRC_Mode=2
AND PRC_Comm=1 AND Ind_R_Speed>0 in one case -- a TRIPLE, which all-pairs
cannot express. 5120 against 4096 is the whole reason.
This is the first unit in the campaign to reach that fallback; every earlier
artifact says `the full cross product`.
WHAT THIS FILE DOES ABOUT IT. R11 takes an admissible STATE and sweeps every
knob through every value with the rest of the state held admissible, so a
triple is expressible: state the OpenLoop configuration once and R11 walks
each knob off it. That is addition, not narrowing -- the 3596 cases are
still generated and still compared, and ranges.toml is untouched. The
generator refused nothing; it was never given a state to sweep from.
ADMISSIBILITY, PER FIELD, AGAINST THE REFERENCE RATHER THAN AGAINST TASTE.
Every unnamed varied parameter is inert-filled to 0 or 0.0, so every array
this unit hands to interp1d has to be named here or it arrives constant --
and interp1d sets aviFAIL = -1 on an xData that is not strictly increasing.
The four OL_ arrays are columns of one matrix in the reference
(ReadSetParameters.f90:719-755) and the two PRC tables come from one count
(ReadSetParameters.f90:432-434); harness/ranges.toml ties their extents for
that reason, and the ramps below are what makes their CONTENTS admissible.

states.name: openloop_all_three_indexed
states.why: PRC_Mode=2, PRC_Comm=OpenLoop, and all three Ind_R_* positive -- the only configuration in which the three interp1d calls and the WRITE(401,*) all execute. OL_Index sits between breakpoints 2 and 3 so the lookup interpolates rather than clamping at either end.

states.name: constant_from_discon
states.why: PRC_Mode=2, PRC_Comm=Constant -- the one arm the 27 scenarios do drive (scenario 25, 15,999 calls), with the three rating multipliers away from 1.0 so a translation that dropped any of the three assignments is distinguishable. PRC_R_Pitch lands inside PRC_R_Table rather than on an endpoint.
